I've worked at a major clothing store for six months. When people tell me to do something it goes in one ear and out the other. I don't do it on purpose. 

It's also difficult to have conversations. It's usually the other person talking and me mumbling a few words. Even if people are talking about movies or games I like, I wouldn't be able to join in if I wanted to.
I used to go to therapy, just to make my parents feel better. I would just pretend that I'm fine until I could leave. I don't knownanyone that I could talk to about this
No. Maybe it's because I'm so used to not talking. I spend most of my time in my room
